take the changes, or drop them
each chat keeps its own provider and model,
and keeps working when you open another;
a second chat on the same project gets a worktree
returns at once; the run goes on in its
up to 3 at once, each with a fresh
context; the explorer can run on
up to n attempts in worktrees; the first
independent parts run at once and are
merged one at a time through verify;
Working on several things at once
Each background task, and each extra chat on the same project, gets its own git worktree: two jobs never edit the same files.
